column1: # Babi Palace sequential dialogue: Colosso questions, rest scenes, and short post-audience exchanges.

column3: Then they have not\nfound him yet...{end_wait}
I told them to search\nevery corner of this\ntown!{end_wait}
If you need rest later,\nyou may use this room\nwhenever you wish.{end_wait}
I feared we would never\nfind a place to stay.\nWhat a relief!{end_wait}
We should rest now\nand prepare for tomorrow.{end_wait}
Then you should hurry!{page_break}The trials have begun.\nGo straight to the\ncolosseum!{end_wait}
Were you hurt as well?{page_break}To be injured just\nbefore the trials begin\nis cruel luck.{end_wait}
Perhaps I can ignore\nthis pain in my stomach.\nI must enter Colosso...{end_wait}
No... I cannot go on.\nMy stomach is killing me!{end_wait}

Babi left instructions
to meet him at the
colosseum.{page_break}Do not return to the
palace. Go there at once.{end_wait}
Oh. Then I must have\nmisheard...{end_wait}
No, I am certain\nit was you.{end_wait}

Babi expects you at
the colosseum.{page_break}Go there directly.
There is no need to
visit the palace.{end_wait}
Here you are.\nRest well.{end_wait}
If you're weary, please\ntake some time to rest.{end_wait}
Are you feeling better?\nYou were troubled by\nnightmares for a while.{end_wait}
What's wrong,\n{actor_name:1}?{end_wait}
You entered the finals?\nAnd fought in them?{end_wait}

How could you, {actor_name:1}?
You have not even gone
to the colosseum!{page_break}You came here to rest
before the finals began.{end_wait}
It sounds as though\nyou were dreaming,\n{actor_name:1}.{end_wait}
You're exhausted,\n{actor_name:1}.\nAre you feeling better?{end_now}
Can you manage now?{page_break}All right, but take\ncare of yourself,\n{actor_name:1}.{end_wait}
{actor_name:1} is awake.\nWe should go to the\ncolosseum now.{end_wait}
{actor_name:1}...{end_wait}
Huh?{end_wait}
You've awakened.{end_wait}
Colosso? That contest\nended some time ago!{end_wait}
You slept for a long\ntime...{page_break}Do you truly remember\nnothing?{end_now}
Oh, please! You were\ncompletely unconscious.\nYou remember nothing!{end_wait}
Of course he remembers\nnothing. He was out\ncold! We were worried.{end_wait}
I'm sorry I raised\nmy voice at you.{end_wait}
You fought with great\ncourage, {actor_name:1}.{page_break}Babi spoke highly\nof your performance.{end_wait}
Are you well now?\nIn body and mind?{end_now}
After sleeping this long,\nhe had better be well!\nHonestly...{end_wait}
If you still feel strange,\nit may be because you\nslept far too long!{page_break}Honestly...{end_wait}
Forgive me. I should\nnot have shouted again.{end_wait}
Babi asked to see you\nonce you were awake,\n{actor_name:1}.{end_wait}
If you're ready, shall\nwe go and speak with\nBabi?{end_wait}
You're all right,\naren't you, {actor_name:1}?{end_wait}
I'm not convinced\n{actor_name:1} is ready\nto leave just yet.{end_wait}
Feeling faint? A little\nfresh air and a walk\nshould help, right?{end_wait}
I'm more concerned\nabout Babi's request.\nWe should go.{end_wait}
Are you certain you\nshould rise so quickly?{end_wait}
That's unfortunate.\nI thought we might have\nshared a good time.{end_wait}
I expected you to go\nas well. Perhaps I was\nwrong.{end_wait}
Did you meet with Babi?{end_now}
Babi needs your help.\nPlease stand with him.{page_break}He is relying on you.{end_wait}
Why have you not gone\nto meet Babi?{page_break}He wants to speak with\nyou before you depart.{end_wait}

That's a shame{pause_20_skippable}... I mean,
that no one will sail
the Karagol Sea.{page_break}Let Babi provide for
you until your ship is
ready to depart.{end_wait}
You have changed your\nmind? Excellent!{page_break}Babi will be pleased\nto hear it.{end_wait}

Then leave the Cloak
Ball here.{page_break}Do not concern yourself
with payment. Iodem has
made arrangements.{end_wait}

The Cloak Ball means
a great deal to me.{page_break}I cannot part with it,
but you may borrow it
for your journey.{end_wait}
